mapper.insert: INSERT INTO battle_history (session_id, player_name, monster_name, player_won, exp_gained, gold_gained, damage_dealt, damage_taken, turns) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{playerName}, #{monsterName}, #{playerWon}, #{expGained}, #{goldGained}, #{damageDealt}, #{damageTaken}, #{turns})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM battle_history WHERE player_name = #{playerName} ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO player_stats (player_name, total_battles, total_wins, total_exp, total_gold, monsters_killed, highest_level, last_battle_at) VALUES (#{playerName}, #{totalBattles}, #{totalWins}, #{totalExp}, #{totalGold}, #{monstersKilled}, #{highestLevel}, #{lastBattleAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_battles = total_battles + VALUES(total_battles), total_wins = total_wins + VALUES(total_wins), total_exp = total_exp + VALUES(total_exp), total_gold = total_gold + VALUES(total_gold), monsters_killed = monsters_killed + VALUES(monsters_killed), highest_level = GREATEST(highest_level, VALUES(highest_level)), last_battle_at = VALUES(last_battle_at)
